transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm just having some issues at work lately. I'm a nurse, and... I just keep losing my train of thought on the floor. Like, constantly. 

It only takes an IV pump beeping, or... a call light going off, or even just someone asking another nurse a question. And then I just... I completely forget what patient flow issue I was working on.
Have you always had trouble with distractibility like this since childhood, or is this a new problem that started recently?

Um... I guess it's not really new. It's... always kind of been an issue. 

Like, even back in elementary school, my teachers would write that I was bright, but... careless. I was always losing worksheets, or just... forgetting to turn my homework in. My mom actually had to sit with me every night just to keep me on track with it. So... yeah. Not new.
Besides the trouble focusing, do you also notice things like feeling restless, fidgety, talking excessively, or acting impulsively—either now or when you were a kid?

Um... no, not really restless or impulsive. I don't think so. But... I guess I do talk a lot sometimes. 

Like... at work, during handoff, or if I'm trying to explain something to a new nurse... I just kind of keep going. I give too much background, and... I talk in circles. I can see them looking at the clock, or trying to interrupt, but... it's just hard for me to stop and wrap it up. So... maybe that.
Have you noticed yourself feeling excessively worried or on edge about work or other things lately, even when there's no clear reason to be?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, work is stressful, but... I wouldn't say I'm on edge for no reason. Just the normal amount, I guess.
Growing up, did you notice this same trouble focusing and staying organized in other areas of your life too, like at home or during hobbies, not just in school?
Um... I don't really know. It's hard to remember. I guess... my room was always pretty messy. But I don't really remember much else. Just the school stuff mostly.
Outside of work, do you currently notice similar problems with losing focus, forgetting things, or staying organized—like at home, managing bills, or daily tasks?

Um... yeah, I guess so. At home, too. 

It's... I just forget things. Things I shouldn't forget. Like... paying a bill, or calling someone back. Even if I tell myself I'm going to do it... or if I set a reminder. I just... don't. Or I miss appointments. It just slips my mind.
Can you tell me if these same difficulties with focus, forgetfulness, and disorganization were noticeable before you turned 12 years old, not just in your later school years?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. Even back in elementary school... it was an issue. 

My teachers would always write on my report cards that I was... bright, but careless. I was always losing my worksheets. Or I'd do the homework and just... forget to turn it in. My mom actually had to sit with me every single night just to keep me on track with things. So... yeah, it was there early on.
